body:
Here are the steps I identified and propose to do:

  - apply CSS classes manually
  - remove theme, themeable
  - keep individual CSS files
  - make the theme a separate package (allows updating the theme without having to update react-instantsearch)
  - add necessary build step to allow
    import theme from react-instantsearch-themes-algolia
    insertCSS(theme)
    npmcdn CSS file for ease of download/test/prototype
  - update documentation to point to npmcdn CSS file, show
  how to load it via npm too
  - update our documentation site to load default theme
